correctness.rationale: On Z=1, fourth powers lie in a cyclic subgroup of order 156 with fibers of size four. The two coordinates' fourth powers sum to −1; the corresponding degree-41 gcd is separable and splits over K. The character χ(x)=x^208 satisfies χ((uv)^4)=χ(uv), so χ(AB) tests the product class on every fiber; the second gcd picks out precisely the five displayed A values, with B=−1−A. Independent exact field enumeration confirms all 41 ordered pairs and the 5,18,18 split, lifting to 80,288,288. The diagonal μ₄² action is free on the torus, its elements preserve the class, and Frobenius exchanges the nontrivial classes. The boundary consists of twelve distinct K-rational simple coordinate-section intersections, since −1 is a fourth power. The divisor of XY/Z² has eight simple zeros and four double poles, so the degree-three extension is nontrivial even geometrically, with tame total ramification at exactly those twelve points. Riemann–Hurwitz using g(C)=3 gives 2g(D)−2=36. On the torus there are three rational lifts of each cube-class point and none otherwise; each rational ramified point has one, giving 252.
residual_risks: The arithmetic is exact for the specified fixed field; it gives no distribution theorem over other fields. No class is assigned on the coordinate boundary.
